description: This file defines the TemplateRange class, which extends TemplateText, and manages range-based search fields for the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for populating search fields from POST data, retrieving field definitions, and repairing custom search field configurations.

classes.name: TemplateRange
classes.description: Extends TemplateText to add range search capabilities, including enabling range search, setting options based on field types, and managing search field configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that maps class properties to vardef keys for range search and options.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates search fields from POST request data, enabling range search and updating search field definitions accordingly.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, including enable_range_search and options based on field type.

methods.name: repairCustomSearchFields
methods.description: Static method to repair or initialize search field configurations for fields with range search enabled.
